verdict.rationale: Appwrite exposes a full public API surface (auth, databases, storage, functions) with SDKs, a documented CLI for automation/CI, docs-as-markdown and llms.txt for machine consumption, and an official MCP server letting agents call the API accurately. This is strong first-party documentation of programmatic/agentic access, though an OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s. Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec and independent (non-vendor) hands-on confirmation of agentic API usage.
